scheme_name: Food Safety & Standards Authority Of India (FSSAI) Internship Scheme
other_conditions: Must be a full‑time graduate, post‑graduate or higher‑degree student from a recognized institute in India or abroad in the specified fields (e.g., Chemistry, Biochemistry, Food Technology, Food Science & Technology, Food & Nutrition, Edible Oil Technology, Microbiology, Dairy Technology, Agricultural/Horticultural Sciences, Industrial Microbiology, Toxicology, Public Health, Life Science, Biotechnology, Fruit & Vegetable Technology, Food Safety & Quality Assurance, Business Administration & Management, etc.).
For internships at FSSAI HQ, candidates with a PG Diploma/Degree in Journalism, Mass Communication and Public Relations are eligible.
For internships at FSSAI HQ, B.E./B.Tech students in Computer Science/Information Technology/Software Engineering must be in their 3rd or 4th year (not 1st or 2nd year).
For internships at FSSAI HQ, candidates with a postgraduate degree/diploma in Public Policy or Public Administration are eligible.
For internships at FSSAI HQ, candidates with a Bachelor or Master of Law are eligible.
Students who have already completed the above‑listed courses should not apply.
Applicants must ensure that the chosen internship location offers the subject/topic they wish to work on; only technically qualified candidates are eligible for lab internships.
Interns must have their own laptops.
benefits_summary: Stipend of ₹10,000 per month plus working space, internet facilities, and a certificate on successful completion.
